meta.title: Irvington parents join call for PPS to slow school closure process
meta.author: KATU News
meta.description:
Parents at Irvington Elementary say they want more answers and more time before Portland Public Schools makes any decision that could close their children's school.

District leaders are weighing a major “rightsizing” plan that could mean closing up to 14 schools and sending students elsewhere, citing declining enrollment, rising costs and the need to better align resources for students. 

The proposal, announced just weeks ago, has brought growing frustration and concern from families at Irvington and across Portland. PPS says the school board will vote on closures by the end of the year and stresses that no final decisions have been made yet.
